summary: First, reporting the accepted outcome: the review of artifact 5448e685a3844063a9d626fe7045b729 was accepted, so c-snapshot-install-commit-context is now confirmed (outcome violated, correspondence no_issue_found, blocker cleared) and unit-c-snapshot-install-commit-context is checked - the eighth confirmed in-scope finding. This submission then opens the second entry point that the previous Candidate recorded. Because a check cannot declare a binding of its own, the startup reconstruction path required its own obligation, so this is a combined check plus Candidate product that creates claim c-snapshot-restore-commit-context with the new source s-api-restore-snapshot (api.go:631-675), the new binding bind-raft-restore-snapshot-commit anchored at the restoreSnapshot declaration, plan check-plan-snapshot-restore.json and harness check-harness-snapshot-restore.go; preflight returns valid:true. Premise: restoreSnapshot publishes raftState.lastApplied and lastSnapshot from the stored snapshot index and rebuilds the committed and latest configurations but never writes the commit index, which is otherwise written only in the appendEntries commit branch as min(LeaderCommitIndex, lastIndex), so a node that restarts from a snapshot publishes zero for an index it reports as applied and as its last snapshot. Harness: a single node commits forty entries, takes a snapshot through the public Snapshot API, reports commit/applied/last as 43, is shut down, and is then constructed again over the same stores; local execution emitted snapshot_committed_before_restart (index 43, term 2, commit 43, applied 43, last 43) and restore_context_observed with restored true, last_snapshot_index 43, commit_index 0, applied_index 43, last_index 43, stats_commit 0, stats_applied 43 and state Follower; the test itself PASSes, so the checker supplies the violation oracle. The plan asserts commit_index == admit.index (equality coincides with not-below because the restarted node's own last index is the snapshot index) with admission alias admit, applicability restored == true and identity fields node/op. Counterevidence retained: the map's min(LeaderCommitIndex, lastIndex) reading, no source statement requiring an advance on restore, and no in-repo consumer other than Stats located. Remaining capacity is now 4 audit units, 23 experiments, 13 semantic reviews and about 11 minutes, so the next turn should review this artifact if it executes.
